v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Exaltáte * Dóminum Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto eius.
text.en: Exalt ye the Lord * our God, and worship him upon his holy mountain.

text.la: Éripe me * de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
text.en: Deliver me from my enemies, * O Lord, to thee have I fled.

text.la: Benedixísti, * Dómine, terram tuam: remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ.
text.en: Lord, thou hast blessed thy land; * Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people.

text.la: In Dómino iustificábitur * et laudábitur omne semen Israël.
text.en: In the Lord * shall all the seed of Israel be justified and praised.

text.la: Mulíerem fortem quis invéniet? Procul et de últimis fínibus prétium eius. Confídit in ea cor viri sui, et spóliis non indigébit.
text.en: Who shall find a valiant woman? Far and from the uttermost coasts is the price of her. The heart of her husband trusteth in her, and he shall have no need of spoils.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Date ei * de fructu mánuum suárum, et laudent eam in portis ópera eius.
text.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands, * and let her own works praise her in the gates.

text.la: Dómine, Deus noster, qui beátæ Birgíttæ per Fílium tuum unigénitum secréta cæléstia revelásti: ipsíus pia intercessióne da nobis fámulis tuis; in revelatióne sempitérnæ glóriæ tuæ gaudére lætántes.
text.en: O Lord our God, Who, through thine Only-begotten Son, didst cause thy blessed hand-maid Bridget to see certain things which are naturally known not on earth but in heaven, grant unto us thy servants at her motherly prayers, to be one day blessed for ever in the vision of thine eternal glory.

title.la: Ss. Sergii, Bacchi, Marcelli et Apuleii Martyrum
title.en: Sts. Sergius, Bacchus, Marcellus and Apuleius, Martyrs

text.la: Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
text.en: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum nos, Dómine, Sérgii, Bacchi, Marcélli et Apuléii beáta mérita prosequántur: et tuo semper fáciant amóre fervéntes.
text.en: Cause there to come upon us, O Lord, a grace from the blessed and worthy wrestling of thine holy Martyrs Sergius, Bacchus, Marcellus, and Apuleius, fanning ever in us the fire of the love of thyself.
